linkedin:
Localizing training videos used to mean booking a new presenter and a new shoot for every language.

We tried the AI route on Synthesia: opened an English onboarding video, pasted a Spanish translation into the same scene, clicked Generate. Same presenter, now speaking Spanish. No camera, no voice actor. (Free plan adds a watermark.)

Where it makes sense:
→ Onboarding and safety training rolled out to several countries
→ SOP videos that change often: edit the text, re-render
→ 140+ languages from one script

What it doesn't fix: the translation itself. Have a native speaker check the script before you publish.

Starter is $29/mo ($18/mo billed yearly). Full breakdown of plans and limits in the first comment.
